title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: mac > Nakamichi 680ZX > Tascam CD RW5000 > Bias Peak 3.21 on G4 Powerbook > wav > flac
source: Nakamichi  CM300 shotguns  > Technics 686 > Maxell UD XL II

ai_review.summary: High‑energy US Festival show with crisp outdoor sound and a jazzy feel; Shakedown Street shines even though Phil’s bass mids are thin.
ai_review.review: The recording captures an upbeat, festival‑morning set that feels tight and snappy, highlighted by a vibrant Shakedown Street, funky Samson, and classic sing‑alongs like China Cat > I Know You Rider and Sugar Magnolia. Vocals and extra wah‑wah guitar cut through clearly, though listeners note a loss of mids in Phil’s bass and an overabundance of sub‑bass. Overall the performance is praised as fun, up‑tempo, and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic reviews (8/9 five‑star) praise the show’s energy and musical moments; recording is generally clear with minor bass‑frequency issues, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals and crisp instrument separation; extra wah‑wah on Shakedown Street adds character. Noticeable sub‑bass boost and missing mids in Phil’s bass rig create a slightly unbalanced low end.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Morning festival slot with a lively, up‑tempo flow; transitions such as Playin' → Shakedown Street are highlighted as especially exciting.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work praised for extra wah‑wah on Shakedown and overall energetic tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted for heavy sub‑bass but missing mids, giving a thin mid‑range presence.
